locked_at_utc: 2026-10-15 (revised: strategies A and B, judged on return per unit staked)
book: FanDuel only (markets FanDuel does not post are used for training, never bet)
picker: six gradient-boosted picker versions averaged (depth 2/3/4, rate 0.1, leaf 50/150), retrained every week on every graded line before that week; inputs: FanDuel prices, model chances (incl. tuned layers), model-vs-line gap, line, game total, spread, home/away, dome, week, market
qualifies: picker edge over the FanDuel break-even >= 4 points; player has 3+ games for his current team; at most 1 pick per player and 2 per game
rank: by the picker's chance the under hits
boost: 30% profit boost on each parlay where available
change_rule: nothing here changes until at least 8 live weeks are graded; changes are written here with a date

limits_tested_2026-10-15.setup: 38 replay weeks, top 8 singles + parlays in rank order, FanDuel markets
limits_tested_2026-10-15.game 2 / player 1 (locked): 62.7% hit, +9.7%, parlays +59%/$, parlay weeks up 26/38, singles weeks up 26/38
limits_tested_2026-10-15.verdict: 1 per game is clearly worse; 2-3 per game is the good range; differences inside it are a few units over ~290 bets (noise). Kept 2 per game, 1 per player: the most weeks up. Only picks that make the bet list count toward the limits.

objective: return per unit staked (not total dollars, not weeks in profit)
strategy_A_bet: singles: the top 2 unders; parlay: #1 + #2 (2 legs, different games; none if they share a game); 1 unit each; 30% boost on the parlay
strategy_B_tracked: singles: the top 8 unders; parlays: 2-leg in rank order from the top 8 (#1+#2, #3+#4, ...); recorded every week, not bet
limits: singles lists: up to 3 picks per game, no per-player limit; parlay lists: up to 3 per game, 1 per player (only picks already taken count)
